summary: Full extraction of the EB-5 part of the US State Department Report of the Visa Office Tables V and VI for FY2009-FY2018 (20 documents): EB-5 totals for every foreign state of chargeability (zeros included), region and dependent-area totals, and the C5/T5/R5/I5 class split for non-zero rows. All printed totals reconcile (rows, regions, grand totals, dependent-area totals). Rows already in the dataset from research:usa-eb5 were skipped and their values match the tables.

observations.location: PDF p. 13, row 'Algeria', column '5th Total'
observations.notes: All EB-5 categories. By foreign state of chargeability ('Algeria'), normally country of birth, not citizenship. Includes spouses and children. Visas issued abroad plus adjustments of status within the US, i.e. EB-5 numbers used against the annual limit.

ledger.contains: Report of the Visa Office FY2009: immigrant visas issued abroad plus adjustments of status, subject to numerical limits, by foreign state of chargeability (country of birth), grouped by region. The file has 18 pages: earlier parts (pp. 1-12) cover family-sponsored and the other employment preferences, out of scope. Table V (Part 3) (PDF pp. 13-18) gives EB-5 by class: 5th Employment Creation (C5), 5th Target Employment Areas (T5), 5th Regional Pilot Program (R5), 5th Regional Target Areas (I5) and 5th Total, plus all-employment-preference totals and grand totals (out of scope). Extracted: EB-5 total for every listed foreign state including zeros, the printed dependent-area TOTAL rows, the six region totals and the grand total; the four class columns for every row with a non-zero EB-5 total, for every region and for the grand total. Checks: every row's four classes add to its 5th Total; each region's countries add to the printed region total; the six regions add to the grand total (4,218); dependent areas add to their printed TOTAL rows.
